Variants.Content: Weeping Town is located on the eastern coast of the Stormlands, near Shipbreaker Bay. It is a port town facing the Narrow Sea. It belongs to the storm land governed by Storm's End. The port serves fishing boats, coastal trade and shelter needs in storms; rough sea conditions make shipwrecks, repairs and lookouts a part of local life.
Entry Weeping Town Local families also rely on water, roads, arable land, herds, and markets where goods can be exchanged; if any road, well, or dock fails, the price falls first on them.
Entry Weeping Town Entry Weeping Town

Entry Weeping Town They also recognize the accents, laws, and credentials of the known world; reputations can travel great distances from taverns, but real distances must still be measured by wheel, oar, or horse's hoof.
Entry Weeping Town Entry Weeping Town

Entry Weeping Town If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.
Entry Weeping Town A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Weeping Town They care about water sources, roads, cultivated land, herds, and markets where goods can be exchanged. They also look at whether seeds are left after harvesting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
